description: Part of `strict`. Types `catch (error)` as `unknown` instead of `any`.
`error instanceof Error` narrows an unknown value to `Error` (or a subclass).
The `{ cause?: unknown }` options bag accepted by `Error` and its subclasses since ES2022.
Links a high-level error to the low-level error that triggered it without losing the original stack.
ES2026 type predicate that recognises real errors across realms, typed in `lib.esnext`.
